current_point.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法Sketch-DBH，利用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储节点度数信息，并使用最小堆维护高频节点信息，实现常数时间内返回查询结果并生成子图编号，确保负载均衡。
current_point.claim_en: Propose an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm Sketch-DBH, which uses Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store node degree information and a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information, enabling constant-time query results and generating subgraph IDs, ensuring load balancing.
technical_features: 使用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
在常数时间内返回查询结果
根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
高效完成大规模图流数据的划分且确保负载均衡
technical_features_en: Use Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store degree information of each node
Use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information in graph stream data
Return query results in constant time
Generate the subgraph ID to which each graph stream data item will be assigned based on node degree information
Efficiently partition large-scale graph stream data and ensure load balancing
